description: This file defines the ComponentNegotiator class in Drupal, responsible for determining which theme or module component should be used during rendering, including cache management and theme hierarchy negotiation.

classes.name: ComponentNegotiator
classes.description: Handles the negotiation process for theme and module components based on the current theme hierarchy and plugin definitions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ComponentNegotiator with a theme manager.

methods.name: negotiate
methods.description: Main method to negotiate the plugin ID for a given component based on definitions and cache.

methods.name: doNegotiate
methods.description: Performs the actual negotiation logic, considering theme and module priorities.

methods.name: maybeNegotiateByTheme
methods.description: Selects a component based on theme hierarchy and provider matching.

methods.name: maybeNegotiateByModule
methods.description: Selects a component based on module extension type.

methods.name: generateCacheKey
methods.description: Creates a cache key based on component ID and active theme.
